content_of_post_to_comment: I'm in a little bubble where we all tell each other "nobody wants this AI bullshit!" and then I go out in the world and everybody is using it, all the time, for tasks it absolutely is not equipped to do. I'm sorry but the pace of adoption of this technology is INSANE.
comment: The interesting divide may not be AI users vs non-users, but people who understand its limits vs people outsourcing judgment to it. Adoption is moving faster than collective literacy.
